_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow template for the local backend. Export your H3 workflow with 'Save (API Format)' and replace the literal values with the placeholders below. castconjure substitutes: {{PROMPT}} {{DURATION}} {{FRAMES}} {{RESOLUTION}} {{SEED}} {{REFERENCE_IMAGE}}. The node IDs/class_types here are illustrative; use whatever your H3 ComfyUI nodes are called. The output node must produce an mp4/webm (e.g. VHS_VideoCombine) so castconjure can find it under history.outputs.*.gifs|videos.
